description: Read one listing: description, price, quantity, condition, photo, and whether instant checkout is available. No sign-in required. Use this before requesting a quote or buying. Pass the exact id from search, for example product_2731.

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731

name: get_product_details

description.description: Plain-text listing copy. HTML and citation markers are removed.

image_url.description: Absolute https URL of the primary photo, or null when the listing has none.

price.description: Unit price in minor units of currency.

quote_required.description: True when this listing has no quantity that can be paid directly. It is not 'the lot has more than 100 units'. Orders at or above quote_quantity_threshold still need a quote even when this is false. The charge path still confirms the seller can take a card.

verified.description: True only when the cached Stripe account can take charges and payouts. A mapped account that cannot charge is false. This is not the viewer's sign-in state.

shipping_price.description: Per-unit shipping as a number, or the string quote shipping.

shipping_price_cents.description: Per-unit freight in cents, or null when not priced.

supplier.description: Present when this listing's seller has claimed a published supplier profile.

url.description: Absolute URL of the public listing page.

title: Get product details
